'''2007 North Dakota State Championship Michael Raveling LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Raveling]] at [[2007 North Dakota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Raelin
* '''Deck name:''' HAPPY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
